title: More Structure Control
description: Simple mod that adds more structure types and structure processors to improve control over them
body:
More Structure Control is a simple mod that adds more structure types and structure processors to improve control over them.

Current version includes:
- Non-rotated jigsaw [morestructurecontrol:non_rotated_jigsaw]: Prevents default rotation when structure spawns
- Specified rotation jigsaw [morestructurecontrol:specified_rotation_jigsaw]: Allows you to set specific rotation for your structure. Use field rotation_mode for this. 
- Increased size and distance limit for both structure types (512 blocks instead of vanilla 128)

If you have any questions/suggestions feel free to visit github page
